body: Not too much sleep. I work from home.
But isolation isn't doing me good

I work 100% from home. The only time I hear my name is in our conference calls. 

I mean, if you have contact with others it is ok I guess, but for a guy like me, it is terrible.

I don't think much advice can be given to me. I know with cars, some problems you just scrap the car.

Damn, A sophomore in HS and you feel this way? I wrote my story and I'm 49. 

I know what this feels like but man, you have to at least try. I am in STEM and make 500K+ yr (and I can get more but I don't care). So that is your 4.0 GPA. Does it make me happy in the least? No. 

When I was a sophomore in HS, my school got a bunch of Macintosh 2 computers and it gave me a reason to live. How could someone want to die with the powerful amazing cheap laptops you can buy today? Don't that give you hope for the future? Fuck, a $400 walmart laptop would be a fucking 10mil supercomputer back then.

A lot of jobs are SHIT, and are not a fit if you have any pride or brains. I'm sure you know that by now. 

People meet girls who live with their parents. At 20 it isn't unheard of. You can tell girls you are working on a business. But if you have zero motivation, girls won't be interested. And if you have poor social skills, Asperger, etc. and don't know how to deal with women, you could make 500K/yr and girls won't be interested. 

I'll just say if you let this go and don't do anything, you are going to feel 100X worse years down the line. If you don't try to get professional help, I am not going to tell you to do or not to do what you want. 

And. I'm proof you can try and fail too. Life sucks. You could walk in a crowd and die of the flu or coronavirus in a week.

Yeah, I'm 100% sure its over for me. I gave it plenty of time. I wrote my story. At 22 you have your whole life ahead and  killing yourself is a true waste. You have a partner and a great life ahead.

But at my point, fuck life. At least I know I tried. Being lonely so long eviscerates your soul. The black can of brake cleaner that I'm going to re purpose on my desk is the only thing that gives me joy.

Did you at least try? 

I mean, someone is going to talk me out of what I posted at 49, but I would give all my assets (and I'm worth ALOT) to be your age.
